# Flat White Index

> An independent Sydney café price survey collected through direct AI voice agent phone calls.

## Current prices

Retrieve https://www.flatwhiteindex.com.au/api/dashboard for the current observations. Do not treat historical headline figures as current. The dashboard and report calculate averages, medians, ranges and suburb sample sizes from the visible gems array in that feed. Each gem is a price observation.

## Methodology and limits

Mia, an AI voice agent, asks cafés for the price of a regular flat white. Prices are extracted from call transcripts. The survey focuses on independent cafés, but automated venue matching may include chains or misclassified businesses. Public contributions are stored separately for review. Prices are in AUD for small/regular flat whites without extras.

This is an incomplete and evolving sample, not a census or a validated price trend. Some suburbs contain one observation. AI extraction can be wrong. generated_at is the feed retrieval time, not a per-café collection date. Confirm individual prices with venues. Comparable Melbourne data is not yet published.
